summary: Full backend + frontend E2E regression of the Loop marketplace prototype flows. 20/20 pytest cases pass covering auth (OTP + brute-force lockout + faculty + logout), verification transaction gate, search/matching (PPT ranks Priya, drone no_match), full SERVICE state machine + review, full RESOURCE state machine + deposit refund, FCFS apply/select creating hire tx, persistence, and insights. Playwright E2E on the preview URL completes the entire 5-step onboarding, session persists over reload, the unverified 403 gate is enforced in UI, /verification/approve unlocks transactions, full hire flow (accept -> pay -> complete -> confirm -> review) works, full rental flow (accept -> pay -> pickup -> return -> confirm_return) works, PPT search ranks Priya first, drone shows no-match empty state, request creation + FCFS Apply on the seeded campus request, insights loads 4 metrics, logout returns to onboarding welcome.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is one 460-line file mixing auth, storage, marketplace, transactions, reviews, insights - fine at this size but consider splitting into routers if it grows.

OTP_CHALLENGES is in-memory (module dict). Fine for a demo but any backend restart clears pending challenges and the FastAPI lockout is per-process only (a multi-worker deployment would allow bypass).

match_score in /requests/{id}/apply uses user.skill built from personalization list (['need','skill','resource']) which never matches real query tokens, so applicant match% is always ~30. Consider using user profile skill/branch or the tags they can offer.
SEED_REQUESTS re-seeds with NOW() at process import (module-level) not each seed() run - acceptable since it's called once on startup.

CORS_ORIGINS is set to '*' in backend/.env but the middleware also uses allow_credentials=True which browsers reject with '*' - luckily the allow_origin_regex overrides it for the preview URL, but a stray '*' still gets registered. Consider removing '*' from CORS_ORIGINS.
test_credentials: OTP: any @student.nitandhra.ac.in or @nitandhra.ac.in email; code 123456. Use a fresh email per full onboarding run.
seed_data_creation: None beyond what the app auto-seeds on startup (providers, resources, req-seed-1/2, seed applications for Priya/Meera).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_loop_api.py covers every documented flow end-to-end and finishes in <7s. Playwright E2E script (embedded in this iteration) covers full onboarding, verification gate, both transaction state machines, search ranking, no-match empty state, request creation, FCFS, insights, logout. All green. Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and every interactive element has a data-testid.
